raw_segments.text: While this pallidness was burning aloft, few words were heard from the enchanted crew,
who in one thick cluster stood on the folksle, all their eyes gleaming in that pale phosphorescence,
like a far away constellation of stars. Relieved against the ghostly light, the gigantic jet
negro, Daggu, loomed up to thrice his real stature, and seemed the black cloud from which
the thunder had come. The parted mouth of Tashtigo revealed his shark-white teeth, which
strangely gleamed as if they too had been tipped by corpusants. While lit up by the
preternatural light, Queequeg's tattooing burned like satanic blue flames on his body.
